description: This file contains the implementation of the DynamoDBReminderTable class, which implements the IReminderTable interface for Orleans using DynamoDB as storage. It includes methods for initializing the table, reading, upserting, and removing reminder entries, as well as handling DynamoDB-specific operations and logging.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderTable
classes.description: Implementation of IReminderTable using DynamoDB as backend storage, providing methods for reminder management such as init, read, upsert, and delete.

methods.name: DynamoDBReminderTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies: logger, cluster options, storage options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB table with appropriate key schema and indexes.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a reminder entry for specific grainId and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries associated with a particular grainId.

methods.name: ReadRows (overload)
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specific hash range.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a DynamoDB item to a ReminderEntry object.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a specific reminder row using grainId, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table for testing purposes.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in DynamoDB.

methods.name: ConstructReminderId
methods.description: Generates a unique reminder ID string based on serviceId, grainId, and reminderName.
